name: task-state-with-files
description: Preserve task intent, evidence-backed judgments, reflections, and step progress in portable working notes across compaction and agent handoffs.

interface.shortDescription: Continue tasks from durable understanding and evidence.
interface.longDescription: Adds a working-note Skill and advisory recovery hooks. Keep user intent, judgments and corrections, evidence, and unfinished steps together; select named tasks and read full records after context loss or handoff.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $task-state-with-files to preserve this task's intent, current understanding, judgments, evidence, and next step across compaction and handoffs.
